address: 353-355 Glossop Road, Broomhall, Sheffield, S10 2HP, United Kingdom
bio: There’s a rich seam of vintage cool running through this daytime coffee shop that morphs into a simple candlelit restaurant in the evenings. Retro furniture, book-laden shelves and a vinyl soundtrack complete the throwback feel, while warm service quickly puts diners at ease. There’s a British heart to the two lengths of set menu, which feature some complex dishes and others that shine in their simplicity – like a delightful chocolate namelaka with miso caramel and toasted sesame. Local Sheffield honey is a feature and is available to buy by the jar.
